topic: VO2 max: the aerobic capacity predicting longevity
caption: Did you know your VO2 max score can predict your longevity? 🏃‍♀️ VO2 max measures your aerobic capacity, with higher scores indicating better cardiovascular health. 💚 Studies show that for every 1 MET (metabolic equivalent) increase in VO2 max, mortality risk decreases by 13% 📊. Factors affecting VO2 max include genetics, age, and fitness level 🏋️‍♂️. Improve your VO2 max through regular cardio exercise and a balanced diet 🥗. 💾 Save this so you don't lose it.
